objects.label: Indian 2-rupee coin, 2019 series (silver)
objects.source: Coinage of One Rupee, Two Rupees, Five Rupees, Ten Rupees and Twenty Rupees Rules, 2019 (Ministry of Finance notification G.S.R. 184(E), 6 March 2019): circular, ferritic stainless steel, outside diameter 23 mm.
objects.notes: Older silver 2-rupee coins (27 mm) are still in circulation, so customers confirm the 23 mm size before scanning (size_check) and the remote pilot measures it with a ruler. diameter_uncertainty_mm is an assumed allowance; the notification gives no diameter tolerance. Thickness is not specified there, so calibration.custom_reference_thickness_mm is assumed. Detection on real coins not yet tested.
objects.customer_hint: 23 mm across. Older silver 2-rupee coins are 27 mm and give wrong sizes.

objects.label: Indian 1-rupee coin, 2019 series (silver-coloured)
objects.source: Coinage of One Rupee, Two Rupees, Five Rupees, Ten Rupees and Twenty Rupees Rules, 2019 (Ministry of Finance notification G.S.R. 184(E), 6 March 2019): circular, ferritic stainless steel, outside diameter 20 mm.
objects.notes: Pilot only. Older silver 1-rupee coins (25 mm) are still in circulation, so the remote pilot makes the volunteer measure the coin with a ruler first. At 20 mm it is more often too small in the image than the 2-rupee coin. diameter_uncertainty_mm is an assumed allowance; thickness is assumed as for the 2-rupee coin.

objects.label: Sri Lankan 5-rupee coin, 2017 series (silver)
objects.source: Central Bank of Sri Lanka, coins in circulation (FAQ, https://www.cbsl.gov.lk/en/node/8034): Rs. 5, 2017, stainless steel, round, diameter 23.5 mm, thickness 1.8 mm.
objects.customer_hint: Silver 2017 coin, 23.5 mm. The older gold-coloured 5-rupee coin cannot be used.
objects.notes: The older 5-rupee coin has the same 23.5 mm diameter but is brass-plated (gold-coloured), which the detector rejects, so no size check is needed. Edge: milled with regular indentations. diameter_uncertainty_mm is an assumed allowance. Detection on real coins not yet tested.
